landing.notice: There are bugs. The UI can freeze, a message can land wrong, the stage can stay closed. Do not use it for anything you cannot lose.
landing.heroLead: Chat on a Nostr key. Voice and live on the PC app. No company in the middle.

origin.lang: Ancient Greek. From the verb ἀγείρω: to gather, to bring together.
origin.title: The name
origin.word: Ágora comes from ἀγορά, the square of the Greek polis. It was not only a market. It was the ground where the city saw itself.
origin.place: Bread was sold there and cases were judged there. Decrees were heard there and the sky was argued there. The word names the meeting place, not the palace.
origin.people: Philosophers, mathematicians, merchants, artisans, whoever wanted to speak. Socrates walked the agora of Athens. The Stoa Poikile gave the Stoics their name. It was not a closed school. It was the street.
origin.why: We chose this name because for us ágora is a synonym of freedom. No owner of the square. No company in the middle. Who holds the key comes in. Who hosts the hall answers for it. Debate does not ask permission.

landing.gitUsHint: Site, issues and the PC app.
landing.gitNostrHint: The protocol. NIPs, relays, the spec.

stack.identityBody: Twelve words and a lock. The account is the key.
stack.web: The site is a stage too
stack.webBody: Chat on Nostr. Voice and camera on a P2P mesh, 720p30, up to 10 people.
stack.wipBody: Errors will show up. Open an issue. This is not a finished product.

you.label: You
you.body: Browser or the .exe. The key signs. Nothing sits on an Ágora server.

split.label: Text or voice?
split.body: Two wires. Chat on the relay. Stage on a WebRTC mesh between browsers.

site.label: Site
site.body: agorafoss.github.io. Chat and P2P stage. No JWT. No Ágora server.

desktop.label: PC app
desktop.body: The same UI in a Tauri window. The stage is already the site's.

relay.label: Nostr relay
relay.body: Signed events. Today groups.0xchat.com. Chat, roles, stage discovery. No audio.

blossom.label: Blossom
blossom.body: Files (photo, video, audio). Chat only carries the URL. The Blossom host sees the uploader IP.

livekit.label: P2P stage
livekit.body: Trystero: mic, camera, screen. Up to 10 people. No LiveKit. No sidecar.

mediamtx.label: 720p30
mediamtx.body: Each peer sends a copy to every other. At home, 5–10 cameras can make the live unwatchable.

lan.label: LAN / Tailscale
lan.body: No TURN. If NAT blocks you, same network or Tailscale.

peer.label: Someone else
peer.body: Reads chat on the relay. Joins the stage on the site or the .exe.

tor.label: Tor
tor.body: Nostr events only, and the WebSocket is not wired yet. Never voice or live.

channels.addLead: A text chat in this square. People who join see the history.
channels.addLeadVoice: A stage: mic, camera and screen on a P2P mesh, 720p30, up to 10 people. Media does not go over Tor. The others see your IP.
channels.voiceEmpty: No stage yet. The + creates one.
channels.name: Channel name
channels.privateLead: Makes a random key. Copy it and send it in a DM. Without it the stage locks. It is never stored in the clear on the relay.
channels.privateTextLead: Makes a random key. Text goes out encrypted. Without the key the relay only sees junk. Copy it and send it in a DM.
channels.keyLead: Send it in a DM to whoever joins. Without it the room locks.
channels.keyWarn: It is never stored in the clear on the relay. The 12-word phrase can recover the envelope. Clearing this site does not delete the room — only the local key, if the envelope is missing.
channels.deleteAsk: Delete this channel from the square? History on the relay may remain.

desktop.webStageBody: The stage now opens on the site. Voice, camera and screen on a P2P mesh. No Docker. No Ágora server.
desktop.webStageLead: This creates the stage channel. Mic and camera open here, in the browser.

chat.emptyBody: This channel is live. Write the first one.
chat.privateBody: This channel has a password. Without it the text will not open.

errors.chat-send-failed: The message did not go out. Check the square's relay.
errors.chat-react-failed: The reaction did not go out.
errors.chat-upload-failed: The file did not upload to Blossom.
errors.chat-delete-failed: The relay refused to delete. No role, no delete.

members.title: In the room
members.privacy: No last-seen. Stage is the only live signal. Bots come much later.

empty.serverBody: Create a square or join with an id and relay. The plus on the left rail opens that.

groups.createLead: It starts as a voice room, with the option to stream camera or screen. Needs a NIP-29 relay that accepts group create (groups.fiatjaf.com only creates on its website).
groups.fiatjafWeb: That relay refuses kind 9007. Create it at https://groups.fiatjaf.com and join with the id, or use wss://groups.0xchat.com.
groups.joinLead: Paste the invite naddr, or the id and relay. A code is only needed if it is closed.
groups.name: Square name

errors.group-create-failed: The relay refused to create the square.
errors.group-join-failed: Could not join. Check the id and the relay.
errors.bad-invite: That invite is not a square naddr or an id @ relay.
errors.channel-create-failed: The relay refused the channel. It needs to accept NIP-29 subgroups.
errors.group-edit-failed: The relay refused to edit the square.
errors.group-role-failed: The relay refused to change the role.

square.title: Square settings
square.memberOnly: Only the square owner can edit this.
square.defaultsLead: A member can already do this. The relay is the authority.
square.modLead: The owner commands the relay with kind 9000/9001. A role the 39003 list does not know is ignored.
square.assignRole: Role name (owner, admin, moderator, or another the relay accepts)
square.nobody: Nobody listed yet. People who speak in chat show up here.

defaults.voice: Join the stage if the channel is voice

auth.meshHint: Drag the cloud · Nostr and Tor in the same square
auth.setupLead: No email, no legal name. A callsign, a lock for this PC, and 12 words on paper.
auth.unlockLead: The lock only opens this computer. The account lives in the 12 words.
auth.sameLockHint: The one you already use. We do not mint another on this device.
auth.advanced: I already have a Nostr wallet
auth.createHint: The name is a mask. The identity is the key, generated in silence.
auth.cadeadoHint: An 8-character lock. The same on every device. Six digits would be too weak.
auth.wordsHint: This rebuilds the account. Lose it, lose the square. NIP-06, works in other Nostr wallets.
auth.nsecHint: The nsec is the raw key. Whoever has it owns the account. Keep it offline — never in a screenshot, email or chat. Ágora cannot recover it if you lose both the 12 words and the nsec.
auth.keptSecrets: I stored the lock, the 12 words and the nsec off this computer
auth.newDeviceLock: A new lock was generated for this device. The 12 words stay the same.
auth.keptWords: I wrote the 12 words down off this computer
auth.revealLead: Write down the lock, the 12 words and the nsec on paper, somewhere only you can reach. There is no 'forgot my password'.
auth.recoverHint: Paste the 12 words and the lock you already use. Same one everywhere.
auth.pairHint: The 5-minute code from the open device and your usual lock.
auth.pairHostHint: Makes a short code. On the other device, pick pairing and type only that. It dies in 5 minutes.
auth.advancedHint: Technical path. Most people do not need this.

errors.bad-cadeado: The lock is 8 characters, like K7M4-2NPQ.
errors.bad-mnemonic: That phrase is not valid. Check the 12 words.
errors.no-local-vault: No account stored on this computer.
errors.no-nip07: No Nostr extension in this browser.
errors.auth-failed: Could not sign in. Try again.
errors.pair-not-found: Could not find that code. It may have expired.
errors.pair-expired: That code already dropped. Ask for a new one on the open device.
errors.name-required: Pick a name with at least 2 letters.
errors.locked-out: Too many tries. Wait a bit and try again.
errors.insecure-context: This HTTP address cannot seal the lock. On the other machine use the Tailscale HTTPS URL (*.ts.net), not the 100.x IP. On this PC, open http://localhost:5173.

profile.name: Name
profile.hint: This goes to the relays as kind 0. Any Nostr client can read it.

errors.profile-publish-failed: The profile did not go out. Check that a relay is up.
errors.profile-lookup-failed: Could not find that profile on the relays.

relays.hint: Relays do not copy each other. A square lives on one NIP-29 wss://. How to run yours: docs/RELAYS.md. Tor comes later, only on these connections — not on video.

errors.invalid-relay-url: Use a ws:// or wss:// address.
errors.relay-exists: That relay is already in the list.

mute.hint: This only hides it on your screen. The relay still has the event.

errors.mute-load-failed: Could not read your mute list.
errors.mute-save-failed: Could not publish the mute list.

dms.title: Messages
dms.lead: NIP-17. A third party on the relay cannot read this.
dms.emptyBody: Click a member or paste an npub. You need the key on this device.
dms.threadEmpty: Nobody spoke yet. The first message goes out encrypted.

errors.dm-needs-local-key: DMs need the local lock. A NIP-07 extension cannot encrypt here yet.
errors.dm-send-failed: The conversation did not go out.

live.meshHint: On the Ágora stage — no WHEP URL
live.ipWarn: Going live reveals your IP to the others in the room, even if chat is on Tor. Media never enters the circuit. Continue?

voice.hint: Voice room. You can stream camera or screen (720p30, up to 10). Off Tor.
voice.passwordLead: This stage is private. Paste the key, or wait for the envelope from your 12-word phrase.
voice.ipWarn: The stage reveals your IP to the others in the room. Tor does not carry voice.
voice.qualityWarn: Capture is 720p at 30 fps. Each peer sends a copy to every other. With 5–10 people on a home link the live can stall, drop audio, or nobody can watch. No TURN: if it does not connect, same network or Tailscale.
voice.noTor: Chat Tor does not apply to this stage.

errors.voice-connect-failed: Could not join the stage. NAT, relay or handshake. Try the same network or Tailscale.
errors.voice-mic-denied: Stage is open without a microphone. Allow the mic to speak. Camera and screen do not need it.
errors.stage-full: Stage full (10 people). The 11th does not enter.
errors.live-no-stage: Create a stage in this square before going live.

clarity.hint: DeepFilterNet 3 on your microphone. The model stays on this PC (~24 MB). It never goes to the relay. Each person sets their own. If it fails, the browser denoise stays.

status.idle: Off. Join the stage to load, or turn it on above.
status.failed: Did not load. The stage keeps the browser denoise.

tor.hint: SOCKS5 only on the path of Nostr events, and it is not wired to the WebSocket yet. This screen stores the address. Voice and live never enter the circuit — the stage reveals your IP to peers.
tor.enable: Use the Tor circuit when the PC app is running (Phase 7 applies SOCKS)
tor.clearnetHint: Text relays stay on the normal list, like

health.browser: The browser cannot speak SOCKS. Open the PC app with Tor on 9050.
health.ready: Circuit ready for the PC app.
health.fail: On, but a .onion relay is missing.
